messages:
Sam - acct_exec: Heads-up, vendor risk wants a "chain of custody" line for CAIQ: they want to know exactly when logs/key custody transfers during a Dedicated POC and what artifacts we can hand over. Need a one-paragraph answer + SOW bullets.
Noah - sales_engineer: Short paragraph idea: 'During Hosted deployments, Redwood retains operational control of encryption keys and infrastructure logs. During Dedicated/Private POCs, customers may elect BYOK and/or external log sinks; custody of key material and long-term log retention transfers to the customer upon successful export or configuration of the sink. Redwood will provide documented export procedures and signed delivery where required.'
Priya - security: Add controls note: mention redaction & PII masking for exported samples, retention_days variable, and that evidence will include KMS access audit entries and config manifests. Also call out transit encryption and region residency for logs if customer requires egress constraints.
Liam - legal: Keep language high level and non-binding. Replace 'signed delivery' with 'export confirmation' and remove absolute timelines. We can include an appendix in the SOW with target SLAs but mark them as 'target' not guaranteed unless in Dedicated contract.
Sam - acct_exec: Got it. Customer also pressed for 'what exactly we can provide within a POC' — they want concrete deliverables for procurement: list of artifacts and acceptable redaction.
Noah - sales_engineer: Suggested artifact list: 1) redacted sample request/response pairs (max 50), 2) KMS access audit entries covering the POC window, 3) configuration snapshot (model version, quantization, runtime args), 4) logs exported to customer sink (S3/CloudWatch) if configured.
Priya - security: Add: all samples will have PII removed or masked per customer's spec. For BYOK, customer is the sole custodian of key material; Redwood will not retain copies of the unwrapped key. If HSM is required, list HSM type and lead time in appendix.
Liam - legal: For CAIQ wording I'd propose: 'Redwood and the customer acknowledge a shared responsibility model. Redwood manages platform controls, operational logging, and key management for Hosted services. For Dedicated/Private, Redwood supports customer-managed keys and sinks; custody of exported artifacts transfers to the customer upon successful export or documented delivery.' Good?
Sam - acct_exec: Yep. Can we also include a 3-line ownership table for the CAIQ and procurement packet? They want plain mappings.
Noah - sales_engineer: Ownership table draft:
- 'Encryption at rest: Hosted = Redwood; Dedicated/Private = Customer when BYOK/HSM chosen, otherwise Redwood.'
- 'Log custody: Until exported = Redwood (operational access controlled by Redwood); Post-export = Customer (customer-controlled sinks/retention).'
- 'POC evidence & artifacts: Redwood will provide redacted samples and audit logs on request; customer owns exported copies and is responsible for long-term retention.'
Priya - security: Also call out 'redaction allowed' and 'export request ticket process' (InfraBot auto-ticket).
InfraBot: Export request created: PR-2026-88. Expected processing: target 5 business days (configurable).
Sam - acct_exec: OK one more thing  procurement wants an SOW bullet about regional residency of logs during POC and egress controls.
Noah - sales_engineer: SOW bullets to add:
- 'Regional residency: By default, Hosted logs reside in Redwood's region matching customer account; dedicated deployments can be provisioned in customer-preferred region where available.'
- 'Egress controls: Logs may be forwarded to customer-managed sinks; network egress rules and IP allowlists will be included in POC runbook.'
- 'Artifacts delivery: Redwood to provide requested export artifacts with agreed redactions; custody transfer documented via export confirmation ticket.'
Priya - security: Suggest adding 'PII masking policy' reference and 'evidence retention_days (default 30) placeholder'.
Liam - legal: Final note: add 'subject to legal review' flag on any absolute transfer or destruction claims. We'll review the CAIQ snippet before sending.
Sam - acct_exec: Great. Noah, can you paste the CAIQ-friendly paragraph and the ownership table into the questionnaire doc and ping legal for redlines? I'll loop in the customer after legal signs off.
Noah - sales_engineer: Will do, ETA EOD. :rocket:
